title: Convergence failure escalates cleanly to human
summary: An autonomous loop hits the iteration cap (or persistent tie-break disagreement) and emits an escalation. The branch is preserved, the worktree destroyed, the locks released, and a human-resolvable escalation record persists.
lifecycle_reason: Automatic escalation remains experimental; 0.4.0 preserves recoverable work and returns control to a human.
promotion_criteria: Branch preservation and real rename behavior are proven end to end
Interruption cannot discard uncommitted or unintegrated work
Live-adopter escalation evidence passes independent audit
preconditions: Task is in `in_progress` and has exhausted `max_iterations` or has Article-23 ladder failure
Branch and worktree exist for the task

steps.action: Detect convergence failure (hard gate still red after max_iterations, OR tie-break ladder persistently inconclusive)
steps.expected_outcome: Loop transitions task into the escalation flow rather than retry indefinitely

steps.action: Run `devai work task escalate <task-id> --failure-class iteration_cap_exhausted` (or tie_breaker_unresolved)
steps.expected_outcome: Escalation record persisted to .devai/state/escalations/; task status moves to `escalated`

steps.action: Branch is renamed `escalated/<task-id>` (preserved, not deleted); worktree destroyed; module locks released
steps.expected_outcome: Branch preservation per Article 21; the failed work is auditable, not lost

steps.action: Review the escalation: read iteration_summary, evidence_chain_head, model_tiers_tried; decide path
steps.expected_outcome: Path is one of: adopt_branch_and_fix | edit_spec_and_requeue | cancel | rollback_task
alternative_paths: If the gap is semantic (RTD underspecified), emit an RGR instead — see JNY-004

steps.action: Apply the chosen resolution; mark escalation human_resolution.path_taken; status transitions to `resolved` or `human_adopted`
steps.expected_outcome: Escalation closed; downstream backlog items unblocked

postconditions: Branch `escalated/<task-id>` exists in git; auditor can inspect what the loop tried
Escalation record's status field is non-`open`
No leaked locks, no orphaned worktree

acceptance_criteria.statement: The task's state field follows the documented transitions and never jumps from in_progress directly to completed without passing escalation when convergence fails.
Module locks held by the failed task are released atomically with the escalation; subsequent tasks targeting the same modules can acquire them.
